caption: A candle burns on a table by a dark window at night, and a second flame appears in the glass beside the real one.

sa.check: A candle burns on a table by a window.
A second flame appears in the glass beside the real one.
It is night and the window is dark.

pc.expect: The reflected flame flickers in step with the real one and would vanish if the candle went out.
pc.fail: It flickers out of time; or it stays steady while the real flame flickers; or it remains with the candle out.

pc.expect: The reflection is a mirror image of the candle and flame, dimmer, at the same height across the glass.
pc.fail: It is a different candle; or brighter than the real flame; or at a different height; or upside down.

pc.expect: The reflection does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It slides across the glass; or shifts while the candle is still.
The real flame points sideways in still air; or the reflected flame points down; or a flame detaches.

pc.expect: One candle and one reflection; the reflection stays in the glass.
pc.fail: A second candle appears in the room; or the reflection comes out of the glass; or the candle vanishes; or the reflection becomes solid.

pc.expect: The candle, the table and the window frame stay the same.
pc.fail: The candle changes colour; or the frame changes; or the table changes.
